description.value: OPA! of Greece is a Canadian quick-service restaurant chain serving Greek-inspired food since 1998, with this Vancouver outpost located underground in the Pacific Centre mall complex. The menu centres on souvlaki platters, pita wraps, and Greek salads alongside vegetarian-friendly items like falafel, spanakopita, and hummus. It is a convenient downtown food stop, though its subterranean mall setting means cyclists must leave bikes at street level before descending.
